Enum Class BotName

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<BotName>
com.barbu.api.game.player.bot.BotName
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<BotName>, Constable
public enum BotName extends Enum<BotName>
Display names assigned to bot players.

Each bot seat is randomly assigned a name at game creation.
